what: When a vertical catch line or title line is 20% visible, each character fades in late at a random time between .2 and 1s, opacity 0→1 (1s ease) and blur 3px→0 (.8s ease-out), settling here and there (at 767px and below, opacity only with no blur) — quietly blooming text like the vertical serif catch on a hotel Hero

options.min: Delay of the earliest letter (s), default 0.2
options.spread: Spread of the delay (seconds) — per letter min + spread × random, default 0.8
options.dur: Time for one letter to light up (sec), default 1
options.threshold: How much must be visible to switch on (0~1), default 0.2
options.fx:play: Sending this event turns it on right away, regardless of scroll

use: Your first-line catchphrase here,Second line.
note: When splitting text, elements whose text was changed (inner links, bold text) keep only the text — attach it to an element holding only text in one line. Removing it restores the original first children

from.where: shared.js .k-rand (original js-scroll-fade-textrandom + scrItem — two vertical catch lines in the hero, vertical catch in About)
